title: Reward review
idea: Reward review: Earned items and eligibility lead one explicit claim action
audience: People who need to claim reward within a game surface.
avoidWhen: The UI would imply unearned purchases
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its claim reward priority and explicit commitment contract: Idempotent claim prevents duplicate grants
navigation: Reward review keeps the current claim reward context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Earned items and eligibility lead one explicit claim action
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to claim reward; rewards are authoritative outcomes

imagery.role: Support the actual claim reward context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep claim and store actions clearly separated
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the reward review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no claim reward content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Idempotent claim prevents duplicate grants
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized claim reward content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active claim reward context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
